description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for managing port triggering rules within a network device. It includes functions for adding, editing, activating, and deleting port trigger entries, as well as checking for conflicts with port forwarding rules. The code interacts with device configuration via setStr, getStr, and similar functions, and includes input validation and session management.

methods.name: PORTTEST
methods.description: Determines if two port ranges overlap or are contiguous, used for conflict detection between trigger and port forwarding rules.
